## Preparing the workspace
### Setting up the working directory
```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
require("knitr")
opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Scratch_MF/sc_Mm/analysis/COL3351A5/")
options(bitmapType = "cairo")
if (dir.exists("./Data") == FALSE) {
dir.create("./Data")
}
if (dir.exists("./Visuals") == FALSE) {
dir.create("./Visuals")
}
```
### Loading packages and functions
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(Matrix)
library(R.utils)
library(reshape2)
library(gridExtra)
library("limma")
library(DoubletFinder)
library(SoupX)
source("~/function_starsolo_droplet_v4.r")
source("~/gene_score_v1.R")
source("~/function_runsoupx_v1.r")
source("~/function_samplediagnostics_v2.0.r")
```
## Defining variables for the analysis
```{r}
library_id <- "COL3351A5"
species_dir <- "sc_Mm"
mito_path <- "/camp/home/falism/Scratch_MF/ReferenceLists_SourceFiles/MitoGenes/Mm_MitoGenes_Ensembl104.rds"
rrna_path <- "/camp/home/falism/Scratch_MF/ReferenceLists_SourceFiles/rRNA/Mm_rRNA_Ensembl104.rds"
y_genes_path <- "/camp/home/falism/Scratch_MF/ReferenceLists_SourceFiles/YGenes/Mm_yGenes_PCG_Ensembl104.rds"
rps_pattern <- "-Rp[sl]"
remove_fetomaternal <- TRUE
counts_threshold <- c(1000,50000)
genes_threshold <- c(500,10000)
mt_threshold <- 10
rr_threshold <- 10
n_hvgs <- 5000
```
## Evaluating mapping results
```{r}
mapping_stats <- sample_diagnostics(paste0("/camp/home/falism/Scratch_MF/", species_dir, "/aln/", library_id, "_SS/"))
```
## Filtering empty droplets vs cells (using uniquely mapped reads only)
```{r}
solo_filt.out <- filter_droplet(library_id, 
                                fullMtx = paste0("/camp/home/falism/Scratch_MF/", species_dir, "/aln/", library_id, "_SS/Solo.out/GeneFull/raw/matrix.mtx"), 
                                exonMtx = paste0("/camp/home/falism/Scratch_MF/", species_dir, "/aln/", library_id, "_SS/Solo.out/Gene/raw/matrix.mtx"), 
                                min_umi = 100, 
                                filt = "threshold", 
                                cutoff = 0.1,
                                n = 20000)
```
## QC + Normalization
```{r}
## Extracting cell labels and retrieving them from a unique + multimapped counts
cells_to_retain <- colnames(solo_filt.out$full)
mtx_multi <- readMtx(paste0("/camp/home/falism/Scratch_MF/", species_dir, "/aln/", library_id, "_SS/Solo.out/GeneFull/raw/UniqueAndMult-EM.mtx"), min_umi = 100)
toc <- mtx_multi[,colnames(mtx_multi) %in% cells_to_retain]
tod <- readMtx(paste0("/camp/home/falism/Scratch_MF/", species_dir, "/aln/", library_id, "_SS/Solo.out/GeneFull/raw/UniqueAndMult-EM.mtx"), min_umi = 0)

## Running SoupX (ambient RNA correction)
soupx_output <- run_soupx(toc = toc, tod = tod)

## Creating a Seurat object
seurat_object <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = soupx_output$adj.counts, project = library_id, min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
print(paste("The object has:", length(colnames(seurat_object)), "nuclei."))
print(paste("The object has:", length(rownames(seurat_object)), "genes."))

## Identifying the most prevalent genes in the object (pre-QC and normalization); credits: Swedish Institute of Bioinformatics, scRNAseq course: https://nbisweden.github.io/workshop-scRNAseq/labs/compiled/seurat/seurat_01_qc.html#Calculate_cell-cycle_scores)
C <- seurat_object@assays$RNA@counts
C <- Matrix::t(Matrix::t(C)/Matrix::colSums(C)) * 100
most_expressed <- order(apply(C, 1, median), decreasing = T)[20:1]
pdf(paste0("Visuals/", library_id, "_TopGenesPreFilter.pdf"), width = 20, height = 10)
par(mar = c(3, 13, 2, 1))
boxplot(as.matrix(t(C[most_expressed, ])), cex.axis = 0.6, cex = 0.1, las = 1, xlab = "% total count per cell",col = (scales::hue_pal())(20)[20:1], horizontal = TRUE)
dev.off()

### Removing unused objects and collecting free memory
rm(C)
rm(solo_filt.out)
rm(toc)
rm(tod)
rm(mtx_multi)
gc()

## Adding information about mitogenes, ribosomal and/or y-genes
ids_mito <- readRDS(file = mito_path)

### Transforming the ensembl IDs into ensembl-symbol hybrids used in the dataset
mitogenes <- c()
for (i in 1:length(ids_mito)) {
  mitogenes <- append(x = mitogenes, values = grep(ids_mito[i], rownames(seurat_object[["RNA"]]), value = T))
}
seurat_object[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_object, features = mitogenes)

### rRNA/riboproteins
ids_rrna <- readRDS(file = rrna_path)

### Transforming the ensembl IDs into ensembl-symbol hybrids used in the dataset
rRNAs <- c()
for (i in 1:length(ids_rrna)) {
  rRNAs <- append(x = rRNAs, values = grep(ids_rrna[i], rownames(seurat_object[["RNA"]]), value = T))
}
ribosomal_proteins <- grep(pattern = rps_pattern, x = rownames(seurat_object[["RNA"]]), value = T)
seurat_object[["percent.rr"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_object, features = rRNAs)
seurat_object[["percent.rps"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_object, features = ribosomal_proteins)

## Sex-dependent expression
human_y <- readRDS(file = y_genes_path)

#Transforming the ensembl IDs into ensembl-symbol hybrids used in the dataset
y_genes <- c()
for (i in 1:length(human_y)) {
  y_genes <- append(x = y_genes, values = grep(human_y[i], rownames(seurat_object[["RNA"]]), value = T))
}

### Saving the percentage values of reads mapping to Xist and Y-linked genes
seurat_object[["percent.xist"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_object, features = "ENSMUSG00000086503-Xist")
seurat_object[["percent.y_genes"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_object, features = y_genes)

## Adding doublet classification to the object
seurat_object[["percent.class"]] <- NA

for (i in 1:nrow(seurat_object@meta.data)) {
  if (seurat_object@meta.data$percent.xist[i] == 0 & seurat_object@meta.data$percent.y_genes[i] == 0) {
    seurat_object@meta.data$percent.class[i] <- "None"
  } 
  else if (seurat_object@meta.data$percent.xist[i] > 0 & seurat_object@meta.data$percent.y_genes[i] == 0) {
    seurat_object@meta.data$percent.class[i] <- "Maternal"
  } 
  else if (seurat_object@meta.data$percent.xist[i] == 0 & seurat_object@meta.data$percent.y_genes[i] > 0) {
    seurat_object@meta.data$percent.class[i] <- "Fetal"
  } 
  else if (seurat_object@meta.data$percent.xist[i] > 0 & seurat_object@meta.data$percent.y_genes[i] > 0) {
    seurat_object@meta.data$percent.class[i] <- "Doublet"
  }
}

### Visualizing basic metrics using violin plots
VlnPlot(seurat_object, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
VlnPlot(seurat_object, features = c("percent.rr", "percent.rps"), ncol = 3)

### Visualizing basic metrics using density plots
# Distribution of UMIs/transcripts per cell
p3 <- seurat_object@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(color = orig.ident, x = nCount_RNA, fill = orig.ident)) + geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + scale_x_log10() + theme_classic() +
  ylab("Cell density") + geom_vline(xintercept = counts_threshold, linetype = "dotted")
p3
# Distribution of genes detected per cell
p4 <- seurat_object@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(color = orig.ident, x = nFeature_RNA, fill = orig.ident)) + geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + scale_x_log10() + theme_classic() + geom_vline(xintercept = genes_threshold, linetype = "dotted")
p4
# Distribution of mt.percentages per cell
p1 <- seurat_object@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(color = orig.ident, x = percent.mt, fill = orig.ident)) + geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + scale_x_log10() + theme_classic() + geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 2.5, linetype = "2.5%"), colour = "red") + geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 5, linetype = "5.0%"), colour = "blue") + geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 10, linetype = "10%"), colour = "black") + scale_linetype_manual(name = "Threshold", values = c(2,2,2), guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = c("black", "red", "blue"))))
p1
# Distribution of mt.percentages per cell
p2 <- seurat_object@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(color = orig.ident, x = percent.rr, fill = orig.ident)) + geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + scale_x_log10() + theme_classic() + geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 2.5, linetype = "2.5%"), colour = "red") + geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 5, linetype = "5.0%"), colour = "blue") + geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 10, linetype = "10%"), colour = "black") + scale_linetype_manual(name = "Threshold", values = c(2,2,2), guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = c("black", "red", "blue"))))
p2

ggsave(paste0("Visuals/", library_id, "_percmt.pdf"), plot = p1, height = 7, width = 10)
ggsave(paste0("Visuals/", library_id, "_percrr.pdf"), plot = p2, height = 7, width = 10)
ggsave(paste0("Visuals/", library_id, "_genes.pdf"), plot = p4, height = 7, width = 10)
ggsave(paste0("Visuals/", library_id, "_counts.pdf"), plot = p3, height = 7, width = 10)

### Visualizing all quality metrics in the same graph
seurat_object@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = nCount_RNA, y = nFeature_RNA, color = percent.mt)) + geom_point() +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "gray90", high = "black") + stat_smooth(method = lm) + 
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() + theme_classic() + geom_hline(yintercept = genes_threshold, linetype = "dotted") + geom_vline(xintercept = counts_threshold, linetype = "dotted")

seurat_object@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = nCount_RNA, y = nFeature_RNA, color = percent.rr)) + geom_point() +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "gray90", high = "black") + stat_smooth(method = lm) + 
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() + theme_classic() + geom_hline(yintercept = genes_threshold, linetype = "dotted") + geom_vline(xintercept = counts_threshold, linetype = "dotted")

## Quality-based filtering
### Filtering based on the % mapping to mitochondrial and rRNA
seurat_object <- subset(seurat_object, subset = percent.mt < mt_threshold) 
seurat_object <- subset(seurat_object, subset = percent.rr < rr_threshold)
print(paste("Number of nuclei remaining after mito/rr filtering:", dim(seurat_object@meta.data)[1]))

### Removing mitogened and rRNA from the object to prevent them from being selected for dimensionality reduction
to_remove <- unique(union(rRNAs, mitogenes))
seurat_object <- seurat_object[!rownames(seurat_object) %in% to_remove,]

### Filtering based on the number of counts and genes
seurat_object <- subset(seurat_object, subset = nFeature_RNA > genes_threshold[1] & nFeature_RNA < genes_threshold[2])
seurat_object <- subset(seurat_object, subset = nCount_RNA > counts_threshold[1] & nCount_RNA < counts_threshold[2])
print(paste("Number of nuclei remaining after count/genes filtering:", dim(seurat_object@meta.data)[1]))

### Fetomaternal doublet treatment 
print(paste("The number of putative fetomaternal doublets is:", length(colnames(seurat_object[,seurat_object@meta.data$percent.class == "Doublet"]))))
if(remove_fetomaternal == TRUE) {
  seurat_object <- subset(seurat_object, subset = percent.class != "Doublet")
  print(paste("Number of cells remaining after removal of putative fetomaternal doublets:", dim(seurat_object@meta.data)[1]))
} else {
  print("Chose not to remove fetomaternal doublets. Continuing.")
}

### Identifying the most prevalent genes across nuclei (post-filtering)
C <- seurat_object@assays$RNA@counts
C <- Matrix::t(Matrix::t(C)/Matrix::colSums(C)) * 100
most_expressed <- order(apply(C, 1, median), decreasing = T)[20:1]
pdf(paste0("Visuals/", library_id, "_TopGenesPostFilter.pdf"), width = 20, height = 10)
par(mar = c(3, 13, 2, 1))
boxplot(as.matrix(t(C[most_expressed, ])), cex.axis = 0.6, cex = 0.1, las = 1, xlab = "% total count per cell",col = (scales::hue_pal())(20)[20:1], horizontal = TRUE)
dev.off()

## Normalization, Selection of Highly Variable Genes, Scaling, Dimensionality Reduction
seurat_object <- NormalizeData(seurat_object, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000, verbose = T)
seurat_object <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_object, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = n_hvgs, verbose = T)
all.genes <- rownames(seurat_object)
seurat_object <- ScaleData(seurat_object, features = all.genes, verbose = T)
seurat_object <- RunPCA(seurat_object, features = VariableFeatures(object = seurat_object), verbose = T)

### Investigating PCs and deciding how many to take
print(x=seurat_object[["pca"]], dims = 1:10, nfeatures = 5)
ElbowPlot(seurat_object, ndims = 50) 

## Identifying the last PC which differs from the remaining ones by less than 0.1%. As before, I will nonetheless use a few more PCs, as recommended when using the LogNormalize method
### Credits for the code: HBC training, elbow plot lesson
## Obtained from https://hbctraining.github.io/scRNA-seq/lessons/elbow_plot_metric.html
pct <- seurat_object[["pca"]]@stdev / sum(seurat_object[["pca"]]@stdev) * 100
co2 <- sort(which((pct[1:length(pct) - 1] - pct[2:length(pct)]) > 0.1), decreasing = T)[1] + 1
co2
```
## Specifying variables for clustering, umap projection and saving files
```{r}
## Specifying variables
res = 0.6
final_pc_component = 30

## Executing the clustering
seurat_object <- FindNeighbors(seurat_object, dims = 1:final_pc_component)
seurat_object <- FindClusters(seurat_object, resolution = res)
seurat_object <- RunUMAP(seurat_object, dims = 1:final_pc_component)
DimPlot(seurat_object, reduction = "umap", label = T)

## Running DoubletFinder
seurat_object <- run_doubletfinder(object = seurat_object, perc_doublets = c(0.05, 0.1))

### Visualizing doublets on the UMAP
DimPlot(seurat_object, reduction = "umap", group.by = "DF.classifications_0.05") #nExp_poi.adj: 5% of the filtered nuclei
DimPlot(seurat_object, reduction = "umap", group.by = "DF.classifications_0.1") #nExp_poi.adj: 10% of the filtered nuclei
DimPlot(seurat_object, reduction = "umap", label = T)

## Saving a filtered Seurat object with clustering information and doublet identification included
saveRDS(object = seurat_object, file = paste0("/camp/home/falism/Scratch_MF/", species_dir, "/analysis/", library_id, "/Data/", library_id, "_filt_norm_cl_DPv2.0.rds"))
```
